ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central and medial lobe areas. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge, increasing in thickness at the distal tips. Small irregular dark clusters and linear streaks are distributed in the lower-central and right-medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated 55-degree internal vertex angle; notch depth is clearly defined relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Variable frequency serrations; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks, while the left lobe trailing edge displays more prominent, jagged valleys near the outer tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular white-pixel nodules (approximately 4-6 distinct points) localized on the outer margin of the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-pixel linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe and vertically near the lower-central peduncle interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular scarring/barnacle colonization on the left tip and multiple parallel rake-mark abrasions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark-pixel closed-loop pigmentation mark located in the lower-left central quadrant of the fluke surface.
